name: loop-engineering
description: Private Loop Engineering monorepo workspace. Install the published CLI packages under @cobusgreyling/* rather than the repository root package. This fork keeps the root focused on documentation, package boundaries, and GitHub API-only audit contracts with minimal-permission token handling instead of local execution entrypoints.

scripts.test:tools: npm run test:loop-audit && npm run test:loop-init && npm run test:loop-cost && npm run test:loop-sync && npm run test:loop-context && npm run test:loop-gate && npm run test:mcp-server && npm run test:loop-worktree
scripts.build:tools: cd tools/loop-audit && npm run build && cd ../loop-init && npm run build && cd ../loop-cost && npm run build && cd ../loop-sync && npm run build && cd ../loop-context && npm run build && cd ../loop-gate && npm run build && cd ../mcp-server && npm run build && cd ../loop-worktree && npm run build
